items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I don't think we had Al in the band.

ctx.x:
I don't think we had Al in the band.
Not that band. No, I can't think -- who was on the -- but, anyway, Dickerson was heading the band.
Oh, he'd come back from New York after going there with Louis, and went back to the Sunset. Joe
